items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met Brenda, a wonderful soprano... So we go together... So I move to New York with her

ctx.x: Where did you wind up when you finally got on your own?

Later on we move to West New York which is like, 10 blocks from Union City. And then I met Brenda, a wonderful soprano, when I, when my marriage was destroyed, a Puerto Rican soprano called Brenda Feliciano. So we go together, and that happen almost 30 years ago. So I move to New York with her, to a building called Manhattan Plaza. Dexter Gordon used to live there and Adam Makowicz, the pianist. A lot of musicians used to live there. Neil Carter used to have an apartment around there. So was a very wonderful…
And so, what kind of work opportunities were you getting during this time?
